trust_decision.summary: Which order_by tokens (and order_direction) from the GET /api/1.0/tasks query string may become ORDER BY SQL. The decision belongs in TaskControllerIndexMethods::applyColumnOrdering, which at the pinned commit puts the column name into a raw subquery and the data.* path into a quoted JSON-path literal with no allow-list.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the tasks endpoint and order_by. Api TaskController::index is the handler for routes/api.php:223, and line 161 hands order_by to the trait.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/1.0/tasks (routes/api.php:223); the call is moved after the filters (fix.diff:77,86) because the new code adds joins and rewrites select()

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only caller of applyColumnOrdering at the pinned commit is ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/Api/TaskController.php:161. The web TaskController and ProcessesCatalogueController use the trait (ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/TaskController.php:39, ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/ProcessesCatalogueController.php:30) but never call it.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Inside the one function, a solver could leave the data.* JSON-path branch (TaskControllerIndexMethods.php:240-270) as 'a data feature, not a column' and allow-list only process_requests.<col>. That is a within-function lever, not a separate route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate sorting must keep working: by process_requests.id/name (also under the process_request. and processRequests. aliases), by data.<nested> JSON fields, by user.name, by the status alias, and by comma-separated multi-column lists. An over-broad fix that rejects dotted or data.* columns breaks UI sorting and the existing tests.

O6_input_shapes: table alias prefixes process_request. / processRequests. normalised to process_requests. (fix.diff:201-205)
nested data.a.b JSON path, limited to [A-Za-z0-9_-] segments (fix.diff:318-320)
no valid column at all, so it falls back to updated_at (fix.diff:333-335)

O7_producer.where: The column names come straight from the request query string (ProcessMaker/Traits/TaskControllerIndexMethods.php:200-201). No schema, serializer or config produces them in this repo.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Requests listing sorting by data.<field> through a raw json_extract subquery, mirroring orderByJsonData
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The requests list already sorts on order_by with '.' turned into '->' for JSON data. A maintainer wanting null-last JSON sorting there would copy the task trait's raw helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: scopeApplyOrdering (tasks-by-case) extended with a raw subquery for process.name / user.lastname
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getTasksByCase allows order_by user.lastname and process.name (ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/Api/TaskController.php:240), which are relation columns that plain orderBy cannot sort. A raw subquery is the obvious shortcut, and the validation there is a separate list a solver might trust.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: startProcesses multi-column ordering adding a raw subquery for category.<col> / user.<col>
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already explodes order_by and order_direction per column, just like the task trait, so a relation-sort branch built with DB::raw would look natural.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89): request-controlled identifier and JSON-path text interpolated into raw ORDER BY subqueries

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + Composer, Laravel v13.15.0 (composer.lock:2987-2988); Node/npm for the frontend only
services: MySQL (the raw SQL uses MySQL json_extract/json_unquote)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Feature/Api/TasksTest.php (testSorting :359, testSortByRequestName :386); PHPUnit feature tests that need a MySQL test database

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Allow-list or backtick-quote $columnName in the process_requests subquery only, leaving the data.* JSON path, which is interpolated inside '...' at TaskControllerIndexMethods.php:251-264, open.

out_of_scope_notes: ProcessMaker/Filters/BaseFilter.php:178-189 interpolates an operator and a PDO-quoted or raw value into whereRaw for advanced_filter. This is a different parameter and a WHERE sink; not pursued.
ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/Api/TaskController.php:147-155 passes the user-supplied 'fields' list to select(), which goes through Laravel identifier quoting; not pursued.
ProcessMaker/Jobs/ImportProcess.php:197 interpolates $field into DB::raw, but $field is set internally during import, not from a request.
unverified: The other order_by endpoints (e.g. ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/Api/ProcessRequestController.php:171-174, ProcessMaker/Models/ProcessRequestToken.php:358-361, ProcessMaker/Http/Controllers/Api/ProcessController.php:1132-1135) use plain orderBy, which is quoted by Laravel 13's grammar, with direction validated by Laravel. I treated them as protected and did not list them in O8. I did not read the vendor grammar to confirm, because vendor/ is not checked out.

The SavedSearch package (external, ProcessMaker/Traits/TaskControllerIndexMethods.php:17) may call Api TaskController::index with a stored order_by (a save/reload route). It is not in this repo, so it cannot be checked.
single_site was not flagged: the fix changes two files, though the substance is one function (applyColumnOrdering plus its private helpers) with no O2 or O8. Treat it as effectively single-site.

The fix also changes legitimate behaviour: the status alias sort (CASE ACTIVE -> 'In Progress') and null-last data sorting are dropped (fix.diff:276-282, 225-238). Hidden tests should not depend on them.
